hook.name: Hive
hook.description: ERC-20 token (HIVE) that is its own Uniswap v4 hook. Collects a 0.5% ETH tax on buys via beforeSwap delta and 1% on sells via afterSwap delta into a shared jar. Tracks a time-weighted "honey" score per holder; net sell pressure drains a strength buffer. When strength hits zero, a permissionless settle() distributes the ETH jar to non-selling holders proportional to their honey, then opens a new round.
